title: WebGL 3D Object
concept: Neap, a tide-prediction app: a faceted, cratered icosahedron moon in matte ceramic PBR floats over a vermilion brutalist hero, and its sun light swings with a moon-age slider that redraws the harbour's 24-hour tide curve.
notes: Three.js IcosahedronGeometry (detail 2, hash-displaced so facets stay closed), MeshStandardMaterial metalness 0.1 / roughness 0.52 / low emissive, flatShading. Phase-driven directional key, orange rim, ambient fill, and an overhead shadow-only light onto a ShadowMaterial plane. Perspective camera, slow rotation plus 0.08 bob; reduced motion renders still frames on change. Pauses offscreen/hidden; disposes geometry, materials and renderer.
